chunks: Imaam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: 'The excellence of the first time over the last time is like the excellence of the Hereafter over the world.'

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Al-Sadiq (The Truthful), a title for Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of performing prayers in their prime time according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Thawab al-A'mal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this profound analogy from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to emphasize that the spiritual merit of early prayer (*al-waqt al-awwal*) over late prayer (*al-waqt al-akhir*) mirrors the infinite qualitative gap between the eternal Hereafter (*al-Akhirah*) and the transient worldly life (*al-Dunya*). This comparison underscores that while both times are valid, the early performance carries a weight of devotion and reward that is disproportionately greater, reflecting the believer's orientation toward the ultimate reality.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2.  Imam  Ja’far  Sadiq (a.s.) says, “The  excellence of prime time  over  the  last  moments  is  like  the  excellence  of Hereafter over this world.”
